title: Four Ways to Nearly Die
dek: An argument about what near-death is supposed to teach you, conducted across four separate opportunities to find out, and won by nobody except my parents, who weren't even there.
imageAlt: AI-generated illustration, in the style of ink and gouache, of a long-haired man in tinted glasses holding a cigarette, smoke curling past his face, with safety-instruction pictograms on the yellow wall behind him. The professor does not smoke.
